title: Evaluation-normalized ordinary coinduction and single-source Hom projection
statement: For schemes [def-pc-scheme] and a Koszul chart T of [def-trf-lci-koszul-duality-data], define its quotient algebra as an ambient module and the canonical ordinary comparison from coinduction followed by scalar restriction to internal Hom from that quotient. Use the ordinary adjunction of [lem-sc-sheaf-coinduction-adjunction] and scalar restriction and coinduction of [def-trf-polynomial-duality-presentation-data]. The comparison is uniquely specified by evaluation on each local algebra section a: its value is the ordinary adjunction counit applied to a times the coinduction section. Include existence with this determining formula. Using [def-pur-hom-complex], on any small ringed site with sheafification, define the single-source Hom-complex comparison, assuming additive target Hom postcomposition: the component in degree n is the actual projection homComplexπ onto source degree zero. Include existence as a natural chain isomorphism with exactly that formula. All other source factors vanish, so the projection determines the map and its inverse.
